description: This file defines the PHPMailer class used for sending emails via various methods including SMTP, sendmail, and PHP mail(). It includes properties for configuring email headers, bodies, attachments, and SMTP settings, along with methods for composing and dispatching emails.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: Main class for composing and sending emails with support for attachments, HTML content, and SMTP.

methods.name: IsHTML
methods.description: Sets the email content type to HTML or plain text.

methods.name: IsSMTP
methods.description: Configures the object to use SMTP for sending emails.

methods.name: IsMail
methods.description: Configures the object to use PHP's mail() function.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Creates and sends the email message.

methods.name: AddAttachment
methods.description: Attaches a file from the filesystem.

methods.name: AddStringAttachment
methods.description: Attaches a string as a file attachment.

methods.name: RFCDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as per RFC 822.

methods.name: ServerHostname
methods.description: Returns the server hostname or default.

methods.name: Lang
methods.description: Fetches language-specific strings for error messages.
